# PlacedGap { #timetoalign.timelines.PlacedGap }

```python
timelines.PlacedGap(length, start)
```

A stretch of the virtual axis that nothing of the root fills.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type                                        | Description                          |
|--------|---------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| length | [Duration](`timetoalign.core.Duration`)     | How long the gap is.                 |
| start  | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | Where it begins on the virtual axis. |
